acceptance_gate: The census decides monotonicity on its roster, and the theorem (toggle width = cutwidth + 1 on connected graphs of maximum degree at most 3, with at least 3 vertices) is proved with executable checks of each lemma, or a counterexample is recorded.
objective: Follows DEEP-HOLES-20261020-001, which proved that an impossible charge network is refuted over every field that cannot compute in the charge group exactly at the graph's toggle width, and that the monotone toggle width is cutwidth + 1 on cubic graphs. Open: can a sweep that also removes vertices do better? Plan: (1) an exact census over all 85 connected cubic graphs with 12 vertices, all connected graphs with at most 6 vertices, and sampled graphs of degree 4, comparing toggle width, its monotone version, cutwidth and the cut game in which vertices may also be removed; (2) a proof: a peak-elimination lemma turns any sweep of cost k into one whose cuts stay below k, and the monotonicity lemma of Fomin and Thilikos (2003, after Bienstock and Seymour) for submodular functions turns that into a vertex ordering, so the toggle width is at least cutwidth + 1 on every connected graph with at least 3 vertices; a monotone sweep costs at most cutwidth + floor(degree/2), so on graphs of maximum degree at most 3 the toggle width, its monotone version and cutwidth + 1 coincide. With DEEP-HOLES-20261020-001B, the depth of a charge hole over such fields is then exactly cutwidth + 1.
status: Complete on 2026-10-20: on connected graphs of maximum degree at most 3 the toggle width equals cutwidth + 1 (peak elimination plus the monotonicity lemma of Fomin and Thilikos; B), so an impossible charge network of three-distinction knots is refuted by any field that cannot compute in its group exactly at cutwidth + 1; in general cutwidth + 1 <= toggle width <= cutwidth + floor(maxdegree/2). The census (A) confirms all five frozen predictions on 1,453 graphs, including all 85 cubic graphs on 12 vertices; removals never helped.
stop_rule: Stop and record a counterexample if any graph of maximum degree at most 3 has toggle width below cutwidth + 1 or below its monotone version. Do not extend to other relaxations or to graphs of higher degree beyond the census's observations.
title: Depth is cutwidth plus one: monotone sweeps on graphs of degree at most three
